notes:
{二十歳|はたち} is a special native Japanese reading for 'twenty years old.' It is an irregular reading — the regular Sino-Japanese form would be ⟦{二十|にじゅう}→二十：00975_nijuu⟧⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧.

SPECIAL AGE READINGS:
Japanese has very few special age words. {二十歳|はたち} is the most common. The regular counter pattern ～⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ is used for all other ages.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Traditional age of adulthood in Japan
- ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧ (Coming of Age ceremony) is held for those turning 20
- Note: The legal adult age changed to 18 in April 2022, but ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧ is often still celebrated at 20

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二十歳|はたち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn twenty
- {二十歳|はたち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧: twentieth birthday commemoration
